name: @pipeworx/mcp-bnm-my

tools.name: bnm_exchange_rates
tools.description: Foreign exchange rates against the Malaysian Ringgit (MYR) from Bank Negara Malaysia. Latest rates for all currencies (default), one currency, or one currency on a specific historical date. Rates are published per session (snapshot time) and quote basis. Returns buying/selling/middle rates per currency unit.

currency.description: ISO currency code, e.g. "USD", "SGD", "EUR". Omit to get all currencies. Required if "date" is given.

date.description: Historical date YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-05-28". Only valid together with a "currency". Omit for latest.

session.description: Rate snapshot session time (24h). Defaults to BNM default if omitted.

quote.description: Quote basis: "rm" (units of MYR per 1 foreign) or "fx" (units of foreign per 1 MYR).

tools.name: bnm_gold_kijang_emas
tools.description: Kijang Emas — Malaysia's official gold bullion coin — buying and selling prices (in MYR) by coin size (one_oz, half_oz, quarter_oz). Latest prices by default, or every effective date within a given year+month.

year.description: Four-digit year, e.g. 2026. Provide together with "month" for a historical month.

tools.name: bnm_policy_rate_opr
tools.description: Overnight Policy Rate (OPR) — Bank Negara Malaysia's benchmark monetary policy interest rate. Latest OPR decision by default, or every decision in a given year (with change_in_opr and new_opr_level).

year.description: Four-digit year, e.g. 2025. Omit for the latest OPR level.

tools.name: bnm_base_rate
tools.description: Fetch the latest Base Rate (BR), Base Lending Rate (BLR), and indicative effective lending rate for every Malaysian financial institution, as published to Bank Negara Malaysia. Returns an array of bank entries with their current rate levels. No parameters required.Malaysian financial institutions to Bank Negara Malaysia. Returns the latest values for every bank.

tools.name: bnm_endpoint
tools.description: Call any other confirmed Bank Negara Malaysia public endpoint by path and get its raw `data`. Confirmed live paths: "interest-rate" (interbank/money-market deposit rates by tenor), "interest-volume" (transaction volumes by tenor), "islamic-interbank-rate", "kl-usd-reference-rate" (KL USD/MYR reference rate), "usd-interbank-intraday-rate" (intraday hi/lo). Also accepts the documented sub-path forms (e.g. "exchange-rate/USD", "opr/year/2025") if you need a path not covered by a dedicated tool.

path.description: Endpoint path under https://api.bnm.gov.my/public/ — e.g. "interest-rate", "islamic-interbank-rate", "kl-usd-reference-rate". No leading slash needed.

query.description: Optional query parameters as key/value pairs, e.g. {"session":"1130","quote":"rm"}.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-bnm-my forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the bnm-my pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
